title: Live news: Bitcoin posts sixth weekly loss as tech stocks and metals slide
content: Strategy and Strive fall sharply in premarket trading as a strong dollar and elevated Treasury yields add pressure on risk assets.

title: FOMC minutes, Nvidia earnings, Russia’s retail crypto rules: Crypto Week Ahead
content: Your look at what’s coming in the week starting Nov. 16.

title: JPMorgan and DBS let clients move dollars across borders on weekends
content: DBS and JPMorgan have connected their blockchain-based deposit networks, letting approved clients move tokenized U.S. dollars between Singapore and the U.S. at any time, including weekends.

title: Vitalik Buterin flips to ‘total bull’ on a faster route to quantum-safe Ethereum
content: A proposed system would combine bulky digital signatures into a shared proof, helping protect wallets without making every payment much more expensive.

title: Bitcoin miners were hijacked and their BTC rewards redirected to an attacker
content: Luxor said just over a dozen customers were affected and will be reimbursed after their machines were redirected to another mining pool.

title: DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
content: Ant International is the first customer to use the service, which lets clients transfer US dollar deposits between Singapore and the US.

title: Harvard, Dartmouth keep Bitcoin ETF stakes steady as fund gains 42% in Q3
content: Harvard’s gold ETF share count rose nearly 20-fold in Q3, while Dartmouth kept its positions in Solana and Ether staking ETFs unchanged.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Aster CEO suspects foul play after token plunges 32% in minutes
content: Aster’s CEO attributed the extreme volatility to highly leveraged liquidations but said the exchange remained operational.

title: Asian chip stocks tumble ahead of Nvidia Q3 earnings
content: The weakness came amid a wider sell-off in regional equity markets, with Japan’s Nikkei 225 down 2% and South Korea’s Kospi losing 2.6%.

title: Elon Musk Joins 160,000 Backing Petition to Bring Jensen Huang Back to Nvidia
content: Huang has reportedly discussed a comeback with confidants, but Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says Nvidia needs a "dramatic shake-up."

title: How Wall Street Is Racing to Claim the Onchain Dollar
content: From Goldman and Citi’s $270 million “Project Faro” to SoFi, Anchorage, Mastercard, Visa and Circle, traditional finance is racing to claim the onchain dollar once dominated by Tether and Circle.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Lose $2.1 Billion in November as Outflow Streak Hits Seven Days
content: Spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $185.4 million on Friday, their seventh straight day of outflows, pushing November losses to about $2.1 billion as Bitcoin fell toward $64,000.

title: The Week Jensen Huang Fell: How a Spy Scandal Toppled Nvidia’s CEO
content: In a matter of days, the executive synonymous with the AI boom resigned after 33 years amid reports of affairs and suspected Chinese intelligence ties—sending Nvidia’s stock reeling and leaving the chipmaker leaderless.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Other AI Giants Face Lawsuit Demanding Development Freeze
content: Four nonprofit advocacy groups want a California court to stop major AI developers from building stronger models, alleging their technology could cause catastrophic harm worldwide.
